question: The Kailash temple is located inside ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ellora Caves__**.

• The Kailash temple is an example of rock-cut architecture, representing the epitome of Indian rock-cut architecture.
 
• It is located in the Ellora Caves, which is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
